selection: Only terms whose default Misaki pronunciation was measured wrong in the renderer image on 9 November 2026, with the observed default recorded beside each. Misaki's grapheme-to-phoneme handling is better than assumed: NVIDIA, Quay, UBI, UBI9 and mTLS were already correct, OIDC, PVC and vLLM differed only in stress-marker placement, and an override for UBI9 was worse than the default because it removed the word break before 'nine'. Entries are cheap but not free - a wrong override degrades speech silently - so add one only after comparing g2p output with and without it inside the image. Measured, not assumed; re-measure when the model revision changes.
